title: Protectant Choice and Design
blurb: How ReLeaf picked ACC deaminase, LEA14 and BoPep4 for three different stresses, what the docking and molecular dynamics work changed about each one, and which of the team's own design claims were withdrawn.
blurb_zh: ReLeaf 如何針對三種不同逆境選出 ACC 去胺酶 (ACC deaminase)、LEA14 與 BoPep4，對接 (docking) 與分子動力學 (molecular dynamics) 工作改變了哪些設計決定，以及團隊自己撤回了哪些設計主張。

questions.q: Name the three protectants and say which stress each one was brought in to cover.
questions.q_zh: 請說出三種保護劑，並說明各自是為了應對哪一種逆境而納入。
questions.answer: BoPep4 is a 23-residue plant elicitor peptide from Brassica oleracea that signals drought stress through the PEPR1 receptor. LEA14 is a folded late embryogenesis abundant protein that stabilises other proteins under drought, salinity and osmotic stress. ACC deaminase lowers stress-induced ethylene and was added specifically because it covers heat stress, which the other two do not. BoPep4 took most of the modelling effort because it is the only one of the three with a solved receptor complex to work from.
questions.answer_zh: BoPep4 是來自甘藍 (Brassica oleracea) 的 23 個胺基酸植物誘導肽，透過 PEPR1 受體傳遞乾旱逆境訊號。LEA14 是具摺疊結構的晚期胚胎豐富蛋白 (late embryogenesis abundant protein)，在乾旱、鹽害與滲透逆境下穩定其他蛋白質。ACC 去胺酶降低逆境誘導的乙烯，之所以加入正是因為它能補上另外兩者無法處理的熱逆境。BoPep4 吃掉最多模擬工作量，因為三者中只有它有已解出的受體複合體可依據。
questions.trap: Saying all three cover all three stresses; the wiki's whole argument is that each one fills a different gap.
questions.trap_zh: 說三者都能處理三種逆境；維基的論點正是每一種補不同的缺口。

questions.q: AtPEP1 is far better characterised than BoPep4 and has the crystal structure. Why engineer BoPep4 instead?
questions.q_zh: AtPEP1 的研究遠比 BoPep4 完整，而且晶體結構就是它的。為什麼改去改造 BoPep4？
questions.answer: Four reasons are on Methodology. AtPEP1 is known mainly for biotic stress, while the project needed a peptide answering measurable abiotic stress, which is what the sensors detect. Drought was shown by our own analysis to be prominent in Taiwan and is directly signalled by BoPep4. An abiotic readout also lets us score direct plant phenotypes such as root length and biomass instead of staging an interaction with another organism. And BoPep4's variable N-terminus with an intact conserved C-terminal PEP motif gives a place to mutate without touching the activity core.
questions.answer_zh: 方法論頁列出四個理由。AtPEP1 主要以生物性逆境著稱，而本專案需要能回應「可量測的非生物逆境」的肽，因為那才是感測器偵測的對象。我們自己的分析顯示乾旱在台灣相當突出，而 BoPep4 直接傳遞乾旱訊號。非生物性的讀出也讓我們能直接量植物表現型，例如根長與生物量，而不必安排與另一個生物的交互作用。此外 BoPep4 的 N 端變異度高、C 端保守 PEP 模組 (PEP motif) 完整，提供了不動活性核心也能突變的位置。
questions.trap: Claiming BoPep4 binds better than AtPEP1; no affinity comparison on this wiki supports that.
questions.trap_zh: 聲稱 BoPep4 的結合比 AtPEP1 更好；本維基沒有任何親和力比較支持這一點。

questions.q: The LEA family contains both folded proteins and intrinsically disordered ones. Why did you take LEA14, and what did that choice buy you?
questions.q_zh: LEA 家族同時包含摺疊蛋白與本質無序蛋白 (intrinsically disordered protein)。為什麼選 LEA14，這個選擇換到了什麼？
questions.answer: We deliberately took an ordered, globular member. Methodology says LEA14's defined three-dimensional structure gives a stable scaffold for the protein-protein interactions that its stabilisation function runs on, and that mutation methods written for folded proteins cannot be read the same way on a highly disordered peptide. Unlike BoPep4 it does not depend on one dedicated receptor, so its protection can involve many cellular partners. Its 150-plus residues also pose a different design problem from a short receptor-binding peptide, with far more positions to mutate, and its drought, osmotic and salt protection gives a measurable wet-lab phenotype.
questions.answer_zh: 我們刻意選了有序的球狀成員。方法論頁說 LEA14 明確的三維結構為其穩定功能所依賴的蛋白質交互作用提供穩定骨架，而為摺疊蛋白設計的突變方法無法以同樣方式套用在高度無序的肽上。與 BoPep4 不同，它不依賴單一專屬受體，保護作用可涉及多種細胞內夥伴。它 150 個以上胺基酸的長度也帶來和短受體結合肽不同的設計問題，可突變位置多得多；而它對乾旱、滲透與鹽逆境的保護提供可量測的濕式實驗表現型。
questions.trap: Describing LEA14 as intrinsically disordered. The Parts page does exactly that, and it contradicts the selection argument on Methodology.
questions.trap_zh: 把 LEA14 說成本質無序蛋白。Parts 頁正是這樣寫，這與方法論頁的選擇理由相矛盾。

questions.q: Where did ACC deaminase come from, and how was the recommendation scoped?
questions.q_zh: ACC 去胺酶是從哪裡來的？當初的建議範圍是什麼？
questions.answer: It came out of an interview with Dr Jenn Brophy, an assistant professor in Bioengineering at Stanford, who suggested it as a third protectant. Methodology records the scope twice and plainly: her recommendation was scoped towards drought and heat, not confirmed for salinity, and she made no direct claim about its effectiveness under salinity stress. We took it because it covers the heat stress LEA14 and BoPep4 do not, it acts specifically on ACC, the direct precursor of ethylene, and it functions both inside plant cells and outside the roots, which gives flexibility in application route.
questions.answer_zh: 它來自與史丹佛生物工程助理教授 Jenn Brophy 的訪談，她建議把它當第三種保護劑。方法論頁兩次明白記下範圍：她的建議限於乾旱與熱，未確認鹽害，她也沒有對它在鹽逆境下的效果做直接主張。我們採用它，是因為它補上 LEA14 與 BoPep4 沒有的熱逆境，它專一作用於 ACC，也就是乙烯的直接前驅物，而且它在植物細胞內與根外都能作用，施用途徑較有彈性。
questions.trap: Saying Brophy endorsed ACC deaminase for salinity. Both passages on Methodology say the opposite, and the Parts page's 'drought, salinity, flooding and pathogen stress' line is a literature claim, not hers.
questions.trap_zh: 說 Brophy 為鹽害背書 ACC 去胺酶。方法論頁兩段都說相反，而 Parts 頁「乾旱、鹽害、淹水與病原逆境」那句是文獻主張，不是她的。

questions.q: Trehalose and proline are the classic osmoprotectants and CAPE peptides are documented for salinity. Why is none of them in the shortlist?
questions.q_zh: 海藻糖 (trehalose) 與脯胺酸 (proline) 是經典的滲透保護劑，CAPE 肽也有鹽逆境的文獻。為什麼三者都不在最終名單裡？
questions.answer: All three were considered and excluded for different reasons. Trehalose was set aside because it is already a widely studied and heavily engineered compatible solute in synthetic biology, so it offered little novelty or differentiation. Proline was excluded because excessive accumulation is associated with cytotoxic rather than purely protective effects, which is a risk in a system designed to produce protectant continuously on demand. CAPE-derived peptides were deprioritised on timeline: synthesis and characterisation were judged too slow for the project window against faster alternatives.
questions.answer_zh: 三者都評估過，各以不同理由排除。海藻糖被放下，因為它在合成生物學中已是被廣泛研究、大量改造的相容性溶質，新穎性與區隔性都低。脯胺酸被排除，因為過量累積與細胞毒性而非純保護效果有關，對一個設計成持續按需生產保護劑的系統來說是風險。CAPE 衍生肽因時程被降級：相較較快的替代方案，其合成與特性鑑定被判定來不及在專案時程內完成。

questions.q: Your Description page says each protectant targets heat, salinity or biotic stress, and your Parts page says LEA14 covers heat. Methodology says the opposite on both counts. Which is right?
questions.q_zh: Description 頁說每種保護劑分別針對熱、鹽或生物性逆境，Parts 頁說 LEA14 涵蓋熱逆境，方法論頁兩點都說相反。哪個才對？
questions.answer: Methodology is the page that carries the selection reasoning, and it says the project deliberately went after measurable abiotic stress rather than biotic, which is the stated reason BoPep4 was taken over AtPEP1, and that ACC deaminase was added precisely because LEA14 and BoPep4 do not cover heat. The Description sentence naming biotic stress and the Parts description giving LEA14 heat coverage both conflict with that, and we should say so and fix them rather than defend both. Parts also calls LEA14 intrinsically disordered, which contradicts the ordered-versus-disordered choice Methodology argues.
questions.answer_zh: 方法論頁才是承載選擇理由的頁面，它說專案刻意鎖定可量測的非生物逆境而非生物性逆境，這正是以 BoPep4 取代 AtPEP1 的理由；也說加入 ACC 去胺酶正因為 LEA14 與 BoPep4 不涵蓋熱逆境。Description 頁提到生物性逆境的那句，以及 Parts 頁給 LEA14 熱逆境涵蓋範圍的描述，都與此衝突，我們應該承認並修正，而不是兩邊都辯護。Parts 頁還把 LEA14 稱為本質無序蛋白，與方法論頁論證的有序對無序選擇相矛盾。
questions.trap: Trying to reconcile them by saying BoPep4 does both; the biotic-stress route is the one the team explicitly rejected.
questions.trap_zh: 試圖用「BoPep4 兩者都行」來圓場；生物性逆境路線正是團隊明確拒絕的。

questions.q: Give the BoPep4 mature sequence, and the alignment numbers against AtPEP1 that let you use the crystal structure at all.
questions.q_zh: 請給出 BoPep4 的成熟序列，以及讓你們能夠使用晶體結構的 AtPEP1 比對數據。
questions.answer: The mature sequence is GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN, 23 residues. BoPep4 and AtPEP1 are both 23 residues and align without gaps, so residue numbering transfers one to one, which is what permits reading 5GR8 onto BoPep4. Ten positions are identical, 7, 9, 12, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20, 22 and 23, and all ten fall in the C-terminal region: 10 of 17 within residues 7 to 23 and zero across 1 to 6. BoPep4 also carries the conserved PEP motif SSG-x2-G-x2-N at positions 15 to 23, and the two places it differs from AtPEP1 inside that window, 18 and 21, are the motif's own degenerate positions.
questions.answer_zh: 成熟序列是 GILIGSKKRPREPHSSGKPGGHN，共 23 個胺基酸。BoPep4 與 AtPEP1 同為 23 個胺基酸且比對無缺口，因此殘基編號可一對一轉移，這才使 5GR8 能讀到 BoPep4 上。有十個位置完全相同，分別是 7、9、12、15、16、17、19、20、22、23，且全部落在 C 端：殘基 7 到 23 之間為 10/17，1 到 6 之間為 0。BoPep4 也在 15 到 23 位帶有保守的 PEP 模組 SSG-x2-G-x2-N，而它在該窗口內與 AtPEP1 不同的兩個位置 18 與 21，正是該模組本身的可變位置。

questions.q: Across your seventeen-sequence Pep alignment, which positions are invariant, and what did published mutagenesis measure for them?
questions.q_zh: 在你們十七條 Pep 序列的比對中，哪些位置完全不變？已發表的突變實驗對它們量到什麼？
questions.answer: Seventeen mature Pep sequences, seven from Arabidopsis and nine from Brassica species alongside BoPep4, were aligned over twenty-four columns. Four columns carry the same residue in all seventeen: Ser15, Ser16, Gly17 and Gly20. Three of the four bury surface on PEPR1. Pearce 2008 measured Gly17 to alanine at more than 4,000-fold down in activity, Ser15 at about 100-fold, and removal of the C-terminal asparagine at about 400-fold. The N-terminal third is close to unreadable as a family: at most six of seventeen agree on any residue in columns 1 to 6.
questions.answer_zh: 十七條成熟 Pep 序列，其中七條來自阿拉伯芥、九條來自蕓薹屬，加上 BoPep4，在二十四個欄位上比對。四個欄位在全部十七條中都是同一殘基：Ser15、Ser16、Gly17、Gly20，其中三個在 PEPR1 上埋藏表面。Pearce 2008 量到 Gly17 換成丙胺酸活性下降超過 4,000 倍，Ser15 約 100 倍，移除 C 端天門冬醯胺約 400 倍。N 端三分之一在家族層級幾乎無法解讀：第 1 到 6 欄中任一殘基最多只有十七條中的六條一致。
questions.trap: Saying Asn23's side chain is conserved. The page is careful: what is conserved is the free carboxylate at the end of the chain, not the side chain, and alanine at 23 is tolerated while deletion is not.
questions.trap_zh: 說 Asn23 的側鏈是保守的。該頁講得很小心：保守的是鏈末端的自由羧酸根，不是側鏈；23 位換成丙胺酸可被容忍，刪除則不然。

questions.q: HADDOCK only searches where you tell it to. How did you decide which PEPR1 residues the docking was allowed to assume, and what happened when you checked that list with an independent method?
questions.q_zh: HADDOCK 只會在你告訴它的地方搜尋。你們如何決定對接可以假設哪些 PEPR1 殘基參與，而用獨立方法檢查這份清單時發生了什麼？
questions.answer: The primary set is contact-derived from the 5GR8 co-crystal: every PEPR1 heavy atom scanned against every AtPEP1 heavy atom at a 4.5 angstrom cutoff, across both crystallographic copies, union taken. That gave 41 active residues and 9 passive ones, the passive set being thin because an LRR domain wraps its ligand along most of its length. The independent check went badly. WHISCY run blind on PEPR1, once without and once with a 352-sequence MUSCLE alignment, recovered 1 of 41 and 2 of 41 in its active tiers and agreed with itself on only one residue, so we did not treat that tier as a reliable check. The passive tier did better, returning the same six crystal-contact residues both times, and seven residues appear in the crystal contacts and both WHISCY runs, which we flagged internally as the highest-confidence core.
questions.answer_zh: 主要限制集來自 5GR8 共晶體的接觸推導：以 4.5 埃為界，將每個 PEPR1 重原子與每個 AtPEP1 重原子掃描比對，跨兩個晶體學複本後取聯集，得到 41 個主動殘基與 9 個被動殘基；被動集偏少，因為 LRR 結構域沿著配體大部分長度包覆它。獨立檢查結果不佳。WHISCY 在不知肽存在的情況下跑 PEPR1，一次不給、一次給 352 條序列的 MUSCLE 比對，其主動層分別只回收 41 個中的 1 個與 2 個，且兩次只在一個殘基上彼此一致，因此我們不把該層當成可靠檢查。被動層表現較好，兩次都回傳同樣六個晶體接觸殘基，另有七個殘基同時出現在晶體接觸與兩次 WHISCY 中，我們內部將其標為最高信心核心。
questions.trap: Presenting WHISCY as independent validation of the restraint set. The page says the opposite about its active tier.
questions.trap_zh: 把 WHISCY 當成限制集的獨立驗證。該頁對其主動層的說法正好相反。

questions.q: Which receptor species did you model BoPep4 against, and what does that do to the claims?
questions.q_zh: 你們是把 BoPep4 對哪個物種的受體建模？這對結論有什麼影響？
questions.answer: BoPep4 is a Brassica peptide and we modelled it against Arabidopsis PEPR1 and PEPR2, because that is where the structural and mutagenesis evidence lives. Peptide Design lists this as a standing limit and says plainly that the Brassica orthologues will differ. PEPR2 is worse off again: it has no experimental structure, every PEPR2 number rests on an AlphaFold monomer trimmed to residues 24 to 710 with no per-residue confidence filter applied before docking, and more docking rigour cannot fix that. The PEPR2 restraints were transferred from PEPR1 by pairwise alignment, giving 39 active and 9 passive, with only 21 of the 41 PEPR1 active residues identical.
questions.answer_zh: BoPep4 是蕓薹屬的肽，我們把它對阿拉伯芥的 PEPR1 與 PEPR2 建模，因為結構與突變證據都在那裡。Peptide Design 頁把這列為既存限制，並明說蕓薹屬的同源蛋白會有所不同。PEPR2 的狀況更差：它沒有實驗結構，所有 PEPR2 數字都建立在修剪至殘基 24 到 710 的 AlphaFold 單體上，且對接前未施加逐殘基信心篩選，而更嚴謹的對接無法修正這一點。PEPR2 的限制是由 PEPR1 以兩兩比對轉移而來，得到 39 個主動與 9 個被動殘基，41 個 PEPR1 主動殘基中只有 21 個完全相同。

questions.q: Your Protein Design hub lists 'residues 1 to 6 can go, the score falls away only at deeper cuts' as a headline result. Peptide Design says the cliff was an artefact. Which is it?
questions.q_zh: Protein Design 首頁把「殘基 1 到 6 可以去掉，只有切得更深分數才掉」列為重點結果，Peptide Design 頁卻說那個斷崖是假象。到底是哪一個？
questions.answer: Peptide Design is the later and more careful reading, and it retires the cliff. Across the seventeen rungs the docking score correlates with peptide length at r = -0.96 and with buried surface area at r = -0.98, and a regression on length and net charge alone explains 93% of its variance. Divide score by buried area and the whole series lies between -72 and -87 with no step anywhere, Arg9 included, and the shortest fragment, a documented non-binder, has the most favourable score per area in the set. The verdict column was assigned by a hard cut-off at -160, which at about -7.4 per residue is a length threshold at fifteen residues, and fifteen residues is 9-23. What survives is that the C-terminal fifteen or so residues carry the activity and the N-terminal six to eight are dispensable, which AlphaFold3, our docking, Pearce 2008 and Cui 2024 all agree on; the cliff is now stated as a range, 9 to 14, and the wet-lab fragment set spans it.
questions.answer_zh: Peptide Design 頁是較晚且較嚴謹的解讀，它撤掉了那個斷崖。在十七個階梯上，對接分數與肽長度相關係數 r = -0.96，與埋藏表面積 r = -0.98，而僅以長度與淨電荷做回歸就能解釋其 93% 的變異。把分數除以埋藏面積後，整個系列落在 -72 到 -87 之間，任何位置都沒有階梯，包含 Arg9；而最短的片段、一個有文獻記載的非結合者，單位面積分數是全組最佳。判定欄是用 -160 的硬門檻指定的，而在每殘基約 -7.4 的情況下，那其實是十五個殘基的長度門檻，十五個殘基就是 9-23。存活下來的結論是：C 端約十五個殘基承載活性，N 端六到八個可以捨棄，AlphaFold3、我們的對接、Pearce 2008 與 Cui 2024 都同意；斷崖現在以 9 到 14 的區間陳述，濕式實驗的片段組涵蓋整個區間。
questions.trap: Repeating the hub's 'plateau then cliff' story as a result. It is a length measurement read as a strength measurement, and the team has said so in writing.
questions.trap_zh: 把首頁「先平台再斷崖」當成結果重述。那是把長度量測當成強度量測，團隊自己已經書面承認。

questions.q: A model passes all five of your triage checks. What exactly have you shown?
questions.q_zh: 若一個模型通過你們五項篩選檢查，究竟證明了什麼？
questions.answer: That the sequence is capable of the molecular recognition step, and nothing more. Methodology states it directly: passing does not show that the peptide reaches the receptor, survives the apoplast, or that binding produces the downstream immune output. Calcium influx, ROS burst, MAPK activation and receptor complex phosphotransfer are read out in a cell, not in coordinates. The five checks are deliberately built to fail for unrelated reasons, so when one fails, which one fails is the diagnosis that shapes the next round. Only the wet lab closes the gap to function.
questions.answer_zh: 只證明該序列有能力完成分子辨識這一步，僅此而已。方法論頁直接寫明：通過並不表示肽能到達受體、能在質外體存活，或結合會產生下游免疫輸出。鈣離子內流、ROS 爆發、MAPK 活化與受體複合體磷酸轉移都在細胞中讀出，不在座標中。五項檢查刻意設計成會因彼此無關的原因失敗，所以當其中一項失敗時，是哪一項失敗就是診斷，決定下一輪怎麼做。只有濕式實驗能補上到功能之間的落差。

questions.q: An audit of your own docking found four problems. What were they, and which one mattered most?
questions.q_zh: 你們對自己對接工作的稽核找出四個問題。是哪四個？哪一個最嚴重？
questions.answer: The founding campaign was eight runs; the five later campaigns were 113. The later runs derived their restraints by measuring which residues touch in the very pose they were meant to be testing, and started the peptide from that bound pose, so they cannot reject their own input. That is restrained refinement, and it had been described downstream as independent physics-based confirmation of the AlphaFold3 models, which it is not. Rigid-body sampling was cut to 40 against a recommended 1000; clustering by FCC at 0.60 returned a single cluster containing every structure, so clustering carried no information; and the unit of analysis became one top-scoring structure with no positive control and no second random seed, so no reported score difference had an error bar. The restrained-refinement problem is the one that matters, because it invalidates a confirmation claim rather than just weakening a number.
questions.answer_zh: 創始批次是八次執行，後續五個批次共 113 次。後續執行是透過量測「它們本來要檢驗的那個姿勢」中哪些殘基接觸來推導限制，而且肽的起始座標就是那個已結合姿勢，所以它們無法否決自己的輸入。那是受限精修 (restrained refinement)，而下游報告卻把它描述為對 AlphaFold3 模型的獨立物理驗證，事實並非如此。剛體取樣被砍到 40，建議值是 1000；以 FCC 0.60 分群回傳的是一個包含所有結構的單一叢集，所以分群不帶任何資訊；分析單位變成單一最高分結構，沒有正對照，也沒有第二個隨機種子，因此所有報告過的分數差都沒有誤差棒。受限精修是最關鍵的問題，因為它推翻的是一個「驗證」主張，而不只是削弱一個數字。
questions.trap: Treating the missing documentation as the finding. The audit started as a complaint about unreported restraints, but the substantive problem was that the runs could not falsify their own input.
questions.trap_zh: 把文件缺失當成主要發現。稽核起於對未揭露限制的抱怨，但實質問題是那些執行無法否證自己的輸入。

questions.q: You ran your docking against a published activity dataset. What was the result?
questions.q_zh: 你們把對接拿去對已發表的活性資料集檢驗。結果是什麼？
questions.answer: It failed. Pearce 2008 measured half-maximal activity for sixteen alanine analogues on the same 9-23 scaffold, so length and buried surface are essentially constant and the substitution is the only large variable. Spearman rho between docking score and measured activity is +0.05 with p above 0.8. The three analogues Pearce measured as catastrophic rank 7th, 8th and 9th of sixteen, and G17A, more than 1,600-fold less active than anything the docking ranked in its top six, scores as a better binder than all of them. The +0.237 the source report had quoted included the wild-type reference point in its own correlation. The co-folding arm failed from the other direction: [A17]Pep1, a designed negative, scored interface confidence 0.73 against wild-type BoPep4's 0.74. Neither method has substitution-level resolution, so neither ranks designs anywhere on the wiki.
questions.answer_zh: 失敗了。Pearce 2008 量了十六個位於同一 9-23 骨架上的丙胺酸類似物的半最大活性，因此長度與埋藏表面基本固定，取代就是唯一的大變數。對接分數與量測活性的 Spearman rho 為 +0.05，p 值大於 0.8。Pearce 量到災難性的三個類似物在十六個中排第 7、8、9 名，而 G17A 的活性比對接前六名中任何一個都低超過 1,600 倍，分數卻比它們全部都更像好結合者。原始報告引用的 +0.237 把野生型參考點納入了自己的相關係數。共摺疊 (co-folding) 那一側從另一個方向失敗：設計成陰性對照的 [A17]Pep1 介面信心為 0.73，野生型 BoPep4 是 0.74。兩種方法都沒有取代層級的解析度，因此維基上任何地方都不用它們來排序設計。

questions.q: Sprints and Results and Methodology both argue for K18R and K8Q. Peptide Design lists both as retracted. Walk a judge through that.
questions.q_zh: Sprints and Results 與方法論兩頁都在論證 K18R 與 K8Q，Peptide Design 頁卻把兩者都列為已撤回。請向評審說明。
questions.answer: K18R was withdrawn twice. The audit killed the score-ranking argument on 30 July. The structural argument survived into August, that Tang reports AtPEP1's Arg18 both salt-bridging Asp348 and packing against Phe371 while BoPep4 has a lysine there. Then the August panel measured it: BoPep4's own Lys18 sits 2.62 angstroms from Asp348 and 4.17 from Phe371, against 2.50 and 4.09 in the crystal, and in three of four constructs it approaches the ring more closely than a re-docked arginine does. The gap the substitution existed to close was not there, so it lost its rationale and was pulled out of a DNA order on the morning of 16 August. K8Q went with the whole point-mutation axis: two methods months apart measure zero contacting atoms at position 8, so a substitution there is not a binding claim either way. Methodology and Sprints still carry the original arguments and should be marked.
questions.answer_zh: K18R 被撤回兩次。稽核在 7 月 30 日推翻了分數排序的論點。結構論點撐到了八月：Tang 報告 AtPEP1 的 Arg18 同時與 Asp348 形成鹽橋並與 Phe371 堆疊，而 BoPep4 在該位置是離胺酸。接著八月的面板量了距離：BoPep4 自己的 Lys18 與 Asp348 相距 2.62 埃、與 Phe371 相距 4.17 埃，晶體中對應值為 2.50 與 4.09；且在四個構築體中有三個，它比重新對接的精胺酸更靠近芳香環。這個取代原本要填補的落差並不存在，於是失去理由，在 8 月 16 日早上被從 DNA 訂單中撤下。K8Q 隨整個點突變軸線一起退場：相隔數月的兩種方法都量到位置 8 上接觸原子為零，因此該處的取代無論如何都不是結合主張。方法論與 Sprints 兩頁仍保留原始論點，應予標註。
questions.trap: Defending K8Q as a secretion handle without saying it was retired. Peptide Design retires it with the axis; the protease-resistance idea has never been tested.
questions.trap_zh: 把 K8Q 當成分泌調控手段來辯護卻不說它已退場。Peptide Design 把它隨該軸線一併退場；抗蛋白酶的想法從未被檢驗。

questions.q: You ran a tandem-repeat sweep on the conserved core. Why is there no tandem construct in the order?
questions.q_zh: 你們對保守核心做過串聯重複掃描。為什麼訂單裡沒有任何串聯構築體？
questions.answer: The sweep repeated the conserved 15-23 unit one to eight times against both receptors and tracked buried area per residue alongside the score. Score rose with every added copy, which the length analysis later explained, while buried area per residue fell monotonically from about 127 to 32 square angstroms, and the number of copies actually touching the receptor saturated at three regardless of n. Repetition does not rescue a motif that does not bind alone, so the axis was retired in writing. One idea survives in a different frame: the sweep asked whether repetition rescues binding, not whether it raises yield, and a cleavable-linker polypeptide giving n peptides per translation event is a real proposal. It needs a protease with clean specificity in B. subtilis, which is not a two-week problem, so it is filed as future work.
questions.answer_zh: 該掃描把保守的 15-23 單元對兩個受體重複一到八次，並在分數之外追蹤每殘基埋藏面積。每加一個複本分數就上升，這一點後來由長度分析解釋；而每殘基埋藏面積單調下降，從約 127 平方埃降到 32，且無論 n 多少，真正接觸受體的複本數都飽和在三個。重複無法救回一個單獨不結合的模組，因此該軸線以書面方式退場。有一個想法以不同框架存活下來：掃描問的是重複能否救回結合，而不是能否提高產量，而用可切割連接子讓每次轉譯產出 n 個肽是個真實的提案。它需要在 B. subtilis 中具乾淨專一性的蛋白酶，這不是兩週能解決的問題，所以列為後續工作。
questions.trap: Quoting the rising HADDOCK score across repeats as evidence the construct binds better. Score rises with length in this dataset.
questions.trap_zh: 引用重複數增加時 HADDOCK 分數上升，當成構築體結合更好的證據。在這份資料中分數隨長度上升。

questions.q: Describe the molecular dynamics set: how many runs, how long, on what system, and what was varied.
questions.q_zh: 請描述分子動力學的這組模擬：幾條軌跡、多長、在什麼系統上、變動了什麼？
questions.answer: Nine all-atom trajectories, eight carrying a peptide and one receptor-alone, 30 nanoseconds of production each for 270 nanoseconds and 13,500 saved frames. Every system was built on the PEPR1 ectodomain from 5GR8, residues 29 to 738, about 127,600 atoms, solvated in OPC water with AMBER ff19SB, with hydrogen mass repartitioning allowing a 4 femtosecond time step. All nine ran on one A100 at roughly 250 nanoseconds per day for 25.9 GPU-hours, one random seed per system, and every number comes from one analysis codebase applied to all nine. Four things vary and nothing else: which ligand is in the groove, which of its residues are present, whether the C-terminus is free, and whether three histidines are protonated.
questions.answer_zh: 九條全原子軌跡，八條帶肽、一條只有受體，每條生產階段 30 奈秒，合計 270 奈秒與 13,500 個儲存影格。每個系統都建在 5GR8 的 PEPR1 胞外域上，殘基 29 到 738，約 127,600 個原子，以 OPC 水與 AMBER ff19SB 溶合，並用氫質量重分配 (hydrogen mass repartitioning) 讓時間步長達到 4 飛秒。九條都在一張 A100 上以每天約 250 奈秒的速度跑完，共 25.9 GPU 小時，每個系統一個隨機種子，而所有數字都來自同一套分析程式碼跑過全部九條。只有四件事變動：溝槽中是哪個配體、它的哪些殘基存在、C 端是否自由、以及三個組胺酸是否質子化。

questions.q: Every BoPep4 construct before August fused six histidines straight onto Asn23. Why did the tag move to the N-terminus?
questions.q_zh: 八月之前每個 BoPep4 構築體都把六個組胺酸直接接在 Asn23 後面。為什麼標籤移到 N 端？
questions.answer: Because Asn23's free alpha-carboxylate is the bond the peptide binds with. In the crystal it salt-bridges Arg487 at 2.40 angstroms to NH1 and 2.80 to NE, and Asn23 is the most buried residue of the peptide at 170 square angstroms, held by Asp441, Asn465 and Arg487 at once. Peptide-bond geometry puts the backbone nitrogen of any residue 24 essentially where that terminal oxygen sits, so a fusion does not weaken the bond, it removes it. The literature has already run the experiment: AtPep2, AtPep4 and AtPep5 carry natural C-terminal extensions, two fail to bind PEPR1 at all, the third binds and cannot recruit the co-receptor, and truncating the extension restores activity in all three. A flood fill with a 2.4 angstrom clearance probe then showed the N-terminus has 111 free grid points and a 6.5 angstrom path to solvent with or without BAK1, while the C-terminus drops to 2 points and a 20.9 angstrom path once the co-receptor is in place, longer than the tag that has to fit through it.
questions.answer_zh: 因為 Asn23 的自由 α 羧酸根就是肽用來結合的那個鍵。在晶體中它與 Arg487 形成鹽橋，與 NH1 相距 2.40 埃、與 NE 相距 2.80 埃；Asn23 是整條肽埋藏最深的殘基，達 170 平方埃，同時被 Asp441、Asn465 與 Arg487 固定。肽鍵幾何使任何第 24 號殘基的主鏈氮原子幾乎就坐在那個末端氧的位置，所以融合不是削弱該鍵，而是移除它。文獻其實已經做過這個實驗：AtPep2、AtPep4、AtPep5 帶有天然的 C 端延伸，其中兩個完全無法結合 PEPR1，第三個能結合但無法招募共受體，而截去延伸後三者活性都恢復。隨後以 2.4 埃淨空探針做的灌洪分析顯示，N 端有 111 個自由格點、到體相溶劑 6.5 埃的通路，不論有無 BAK1 都一樣；而 C 端在共受體就位後降到 2 個格點、通路 20.9 埃，比必須穿過它的標籤還長。
questions.trap: Saying the docking score told you. The score did not: the tagged construct buries 2,261 square angstroms and scores -155.7, better than untagged wild type at -125.9, while making none of the four clamp contacts.
questions.trap_zh: 說是對接分數告訴你們的。分數並沒有：帶標籤的構築體埋藏 2,261 平方埃、分數 -155.7，比無標籤野生型的 -125.9 更好，卻一個夾鉗接觸都沒形成。

questions.q: One of your molecular dynamics runs passed every acceptance criterion and was still wrong. Explain it.
questions.q_zh: 你們有一條分子動力學軌跡通過了所有驗收標準，卻依然是錯的。請說明。
questions.answer: The C-terminal 6xHis construct. All four acceptance criteria passed, the C-terminus scored as steadier than wild type, and ranked on backbone RMSD it came first in the entire set. But Asn23 is no longer a C-terminus: its carboxylate was spent forming the amide bond to His24, so there is no OXT and the two-guanidinium-nitrogen criterion is measuring one neutral amide carbonyl oxygen. The 2.4% it reports is not a weak salt bridge; there is no salt bridge there to be weak. The general lesson is written into the page: an acceptance gate written before a construct existed can measure atoms that construct does not have, and nothing in the score says so. The docking panel made the same point categorically, with that construct reaching none of the four clamp contacts in any of thirty poses and Asn23 sitting 47 to 57 angstroms from all four partners.
questions.answer_zh: C 端 6xHis 構築體。四項驗收標準全數通過，C 端的穩定度評分還優於野生型，而以主鏈 RMSD 排名時它是全組第一。但 Asn23 已不再是 C 端：它的羧酸根被用去與 His24 形成醯胺鍵，因此沒有 OXT，而「兩個胍基氮」的標準量到的是一個中性醯胺羰基氧。它回報的 2.4% 不是弱鹽橋；那裡根本沒有鹽橋可言弱。該頁寫下了通則：在構築體存在之前寫好的驗收門檻，可能量測該構築體並不具備的原子，而分數本身不會說出這件事。對接面板以更絕對的方式重現同一論點：該構築體在三十個姿勢中沒有一個達成四個夾鉗接觸之一，Asn23 與四個夥伴的距離都在 47 到 57 埃之間。

questions.q: What can your 30-nanosecond trajectories not tell you, and how do you know how small a difference is meaningless?
questions.q_zh: 你們 30 奈秒的軌跡無法回答什麼？又如何知道多小的差異是沒有意義的？
questions.answer: Thirty nanoseconds is three to six orders of magnitude short of a dissociation event, so nothing in the set is a binding affinity, a leaving time or a free energy. The 15-23 run was planned as a negative control that would fall off and supply a leaving time, and it could not have, whatever it did. Each system has one random seed, so a difference between two runs may be a difference between two relaxation paths. The floor comes from the apo run: with no peptide the receptor Calpha RMSD is 1.57 angstroms against 1.58 to 2.16 for the seven comparable bound runs, and the groove holds at 35.91 plus or minus 0.55 angstroms, so any receptor-side difference smaller than about half an angstrom is inside that floor and should not be read as a result. And none of it has been checked at the bench: no binding assay, no thermal shift, no plant.
questions.answer_zh: 三十奈秒比解離事件短了三到六個數量級，所以這組裡沒有任何數字是結合親和力、離開時間或自由能。15-23 那條原本規劃為會脫落並提供離開時間的陰性對照，但無論它表現如何都不可能做到。每個系統只有一個隨機種子，所以兩條軌跡之間的差異可能只是兩條鬆弛路徑的差異。底線來自無肽 (apo) 那條：沒有肽時受體 Cα RMSD 為 1.57 埃，而七條可比較的結合軌跡落在 1.58 到 2.16 之間，溝槽維持在 35.91 ± 0.55 埃，因此受體側任何小於約半埃的差異都在這個底線之內，不應當成結果。而且這一切都未在實驗桌上驗證：沒有結合分析、沒有熱位移、沒有植物。
questions.trap: Ranking constructs on backbone RMSD. It correlates with the salt bridge it stands in for at Spearman only +0.29 and runs +0.03 the wrong way against the four-contact clamp.
questions.trap_zh: 用主鏈 RMSD 排序構築體。它與它所代表的鹽橋的 Spearman 相關僅 +0.29，對四接觸夾鉗更是以 +0.03 走錯方向。

questions.q: Why did you simulate at pH 5.5 at all, and what did it change?
questions.q_zh: 你們為什麼要在 pH 5.5 做模擬？結果改變了什麼？
questions.answer: Because the peptide does its work in the apoplast, outside the plant cell, where the pH is nearer 5.5 than 7, so neutral pH was an assumption rather than a condition. Switching His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor to their protonated form and touching nothing else locks the Glu12 carboxylate onto the His227 ring at 2.75 plus or minus 0.11 angstroms in 99.9% of frames, where at pH 7 the same pair sits 5.33 angstroms apart and appears in 0.8%. The AtPEP1 benchmark already makes that contact natively at neutral pH, at 3.36 angstroms and 76.9%, so pH 5.5 recovers a contact the calibrating control has. The C-terminal anchor is untouched and the 15-23 window becomes the tightest of any BoPep4 run, so future BoPep4 simulations default to pH 5.5 with pH 7 as the control. The honest footnote is that the His14 pH-switch idea that motivated the run is not supported: protonated or not, its ring nitrogens sit about 6.1 angstroms from the nearest receptor carboxylate at 0.0% occupancy.
questions.answer_zh: 因為這條肽是在質外體、也就是植物細胞外作用，那裡的 pH 接近 5.5 而非 7，所以中性 pH 是假設而不是條件。把肽上的 His14、His22 與受體上的 His227 切成質子化形式、其他一律不動，就讓 Glu12 的羧酸根在 99.9% 的影格中鎖上 His227 環，距離 2.75 ± 0.11 埃；而在 pH 7 下同一對相距 5.33 埃，只出現在 0.8% 的影格。AtPEP1 基準組在中性 pH 下本來就有這個接觸，距離 3.36 埃、佔 76.9%，所以 pH 5.5 是把校正對照本就具備的接觸找回來。C 端錨點未受影響，15-23 窗口成為所有 BoPep4 軌跡中最緊的，因此後續 BoPep4 模擬預設用 pH 5.5，以 pH 7 作對照。誠實的附註是：促成這次執行的 His14 pH 開關想法並未得到支持，不論是否質子化，它的環氮與最近的受體羧酸根相距約 6.1 埃，佔有率 0.0%。
questions.trap: Saying the simulation was run at pH 5.5. Molecular dynamics has no pH; the label names a protonation state held fixed for 30 nanoseconds, assigned from model pKa values, not from constant-pH MD or PROPKA.
questions.trap_zh: 說模擬是在 pH 5.5 下跑的。分子動力學沒有 pH；這個標籤指的是整個 30 奈秒維持固定的質子化狀態，由模型 pKa 值指定，不是恆定 pH 模擬，也不是 PROPKA。

questions.q: Your ordered lead is BoPep4 9-23. Two of your own runs say something uncomfortable about it. What?
questions.q_zh: 你們下訂的主力是 BoPep4 9-23。你們自己有兩條軌跡對它說了不太舒服的話。是什麼？
questions.answer: At pH 7, deleting residues 1 to 8 loosens the anchor at the far end: the clamp flickers open 94 times in 30 nanoseconds, though no gap lasts longer than 0.68 nanoseconds. At pH 5.5, the condition we now say should be the default, 9-23 failed the gate outright: every metric except the anchor improved and the anchor collapsed, because the now-positive His22 folds back onto the peptide's own C-terminal carboxylate and displaces Arg487. Putting Lys7 and Lys8 back, as 7-23, restores the clamp, and not through a free-terminus artefact, since Lys7 grips Asp129. We should say plainly that the construct in the order is the one with the weaker anchor in simulation, that the failing run crosses two variables at once, truncation and protonation, and that the wet-lab set deliberately carries full-length wild type alongside it.
questions.answer_zh: 在 pH 7 下，刪去殘基 1 到 8 會鬆開遠端的錨點：夾鉗在 30 奈秒內閃開 94 次，不過沒有任何間隙超過 0.68 奈秒。在 pH 5.5，也就是我們現在說應該當預設的條件下，9-23 直接未通過門檻：除錨點以外每個指標都改善，而錨點崩解，因為此時帶正電的 His22 折回肽自身的 C 端羧酸根並把 Arg487 擠開。把 Lys7 與 Lys8 加回去，也就是 7-23，夾鉗就恢復，而且不是靠自由末端的假象，因為 Lys7 抓住了 Asp129。我們應該明說：訂單裡的構築體正是模擬中錨點較弱的那一個；失敗的那條軌跡同時跨了截短與質子化兩個變數；而濕式實驗組刻意把全長野生型與它並列。

questions.q: Methodology specifies a full LEA14 design panel: a K-segment graft, truncations, C58S, D78E. Where are the results?
questions.q_zh: 方法論頁訂出了完整的 LEA14 設計面板：K 片段嫁接、截短、C58S、D78E。結果在哪裡？
questions.answer: There are none. Sprints and Results says it in one line: every LEA14 run is outstanding, and none of the designs has been docked or simulated. That covers the two K-segment grafts on full-length and truncated core joined by a GGGGS linker, the three truncations T1-16, T1-23 and T146-151, C58S, and the truncation ladder and alanine scan that BoPep4 has and LEA14 does not. Molecular Dynamics lists LEA14 and ACC deaminase as future, not started. So the LEA14 reasoning is a set of structural hypotheses with bench tests attached, a non-reducing gel for the C58S dimerisation hypothesis and a trypsin challenge for the truncation, not a modelling result. ACC deaminase is further along on the docking side: Y156C, V293T, removal of six unpaired cysteines and a PLP binding test have run, while AlphaFold folding consistency, the 39 to 50 lid loop and the blocking-residue measurement have not.
questions.answer_zh: 沒有結果。Sprints and Results 頁用一句話說明：LEA14 的所有執行都還沒做，沒有任何設計被對接或模擬。這包含以 GGGGS 連接子接在全長與截短核心上的兩個 K 片段嫁接、三個截短 T1-16、T1-23、T146-151、C58S，以及 BoPep4 有而 LEA14 沒有的截短階梯與丙胺酸掃描。Molecular Dynamics 頁把 LEA14 與 ACC 去胺酶列為未來、尚未開始。所以 LEA14 的推理是一組附帶實驗檢驗的結構假說——C58S 二聚化假說用非還原膠、截短用胰蛋白酶挑戰——而不是模擬結果。ACC 去胺酶在對接端走得較遠：Y156C、V293T、移除六個未配對半胱胺酸與 PLP 結合測試都已執行，而 AlphaFold 摺疊一致性、39 到 50 的蓋環與阻擋殘基量測則尚未。
questions.trap: Presenting the LEA14 panel as work that was done. It is specified, not run, and Sprints says so in plain words.
questions.trap_zh: 把 LEA14 面板說成已完成的工作。它只是被規劃，沒有執行，Sprints 頁用白話寫明。

questions.q: You did a family-wide alignment for the Pep peptides but not for LEA14, and you dropped a whole class of LEA14 substitutions. Why both?
questions.q_zh: 你們對 Pep 肽做了家族層級的比對，卻沒對 LEA14 做，而且捨棄了一整類 LEA14 的取代。兩個決定的理由是什麼？
questions.answer: The alignment was skipped because sequence conservation alone is less informative there: the LEA family spans intrinsically disordered and folded members, so similar sequence patterns need not correspond to equivalent structural or functional roles. LEA14 was analysed instead as a specific folded protein, on its experimentally characterised structure, residue environment, interaction surfaces and the liabilities of our delivery route, so each proposed mutation connects to a defined structural hypothesis. The dropped class is surface hydrophilicity substitutions: LEA14's GRAVY value of +0.056 is unusual for a stress-protective protein and could be lowered, but doing so would work against the fold, and the bulk hydration shielding mechanism those substitutions would serve is the mechanism our own feasibility analysis argues is not available at any deliverable concentration.
questions.answer_zh: 跳過比對是因為在這裡單憑序列保守性資訊量較低：LEA 家族橫跨本質無序與摺疊成員，相似的序列模式不必然對應等價的結構或功能角色。LEA14 改以特定摺疊蛋白的方式分析，依據其已實驗鑑定的結構、殘基環境、交互作用表面，以及我們遞送途徑帶來的弱點，使每個提議的突變都連到一個明確的結構假說。被捨棄的那一類是表面親水性取代：LEA14 的 GRAVY 值 +0.056 對逆境保護蛋白來說不尋常，確實可以降低，但那會與摺疊相抗；而這些取代要服務的整體水合屏蔽機制，正是我們自己的可行性分析認為在任何可遞送濃度下都無法成立的機制。

questions.q: Your first codon optimiser was replaced. What was wrong with it, and what replaced it?
questions.q_zh: 你們第一版的密碼子最佳化程式被換掉了。原本錯在哪裡，換成了什麼？
questions.answer: The first optimiser ranked roughly 50,000 synonymous draws per payload by the sum of two accessibilities, the unpaired probability over the fifteen bases from the start codon and over the Shine-Dalgarno core. A sum lets the search buy a large gain in one term with a total loss in the other, and that is what happened: the design it returned had start accessibility 0.911 and a Shine-Dalgarno core at 0.050, more occluded than the wild-type sequence it replaced. Ranking moved to the bottleneck, J equals the minimum of the two, and the random draw was replaced with a deterministic descent over the codons that actually base-pair with the initiation region. On BoPep4 the bottleneck went from 0.067 to 0.528 at a codon adaptation index of 0.78, against a working reference gene in this chassis, ho1, at 0.681. Two results contradict standard practice: optimising codon adaptation alone gives an index of 0.87 to 0.89 with a bottleneck near 0.054 and an essentially fully occluded ribosome binding site, and the published low-GC heuristic we ran as a literature control made one payload worse than its own wild type.
questions.answer_zh: 第一版程式對每個貨物序列排序約 50,000 個同義抽樣，依據的是兩個可及性之和：起始密碼子起算十五個鹼基的未配對機率，以及 Shine-Dalgarno 核心的未配對機率。用「和」會讓搜尋以一項的巨大增益換取另一項的完全失守，而這正是發生的事：它回傳的設計起始可及性 0.911，Shine-Dalgarno 核心卻只有 0.050，比它取代的野生型序列遮蔽得更嚴重。排序改用瓶頸值，J 等於兩者的最小值，隨機抽樣也換成對真正與起始區配對的密碼子做確定性下降。在 BoPep4 上瓶頸值從 0.067 提升到 0.528，密碼子適應指數 (CAI) 為 0.78，而此底盤中可運作的參考基因 ho1 為 0.681。兩個結果與常規做法相反：單獨最佳化密碼子適應會得到 0.87 到 0.89 的指數，瓶頸值卻接近 0.054，核糖體結合位基本完全遮蔽；而我們作為文獻對照跑的已發表低 GC 經驗法則，讓其中一個貨物序列比它自己的野生型更差。
questions.trap: Quoting the balance score as the objective. Methodology still states bal = start+15 + SD core, which is the summed objective Peptide Design replaced; the two pages need reconciling.
questions.trap_zh: 把平衡分數當成目標函數引用。方法論頁仍寫 bal = start+15 + SD core，那正是 Peptide Design 頁取代掉的加總目標；兩頁需要對齊。

questions.q: Your codon model and your signal peptide screen both produce rankings. What do those rankings not predict?
questions.q_zh: 你們的密碼子模型與訊號肽篩選都產出排名。這些排名無法預測什麼？
questions.answer: The codon model ranks precursor supply only. Peptide Design states it: it says nothing about signal-recognition targeting, translocase throughput, or the quality-control proteases waiting on the far side of the membrane, and it is not a yield prediction. The signal peptide panel was ranked on n-region charge, h-region hydrophobicity and length, and the minus-3 and minus-1 cleavage rule from verified UniProt sequences. SamyQ, already in our cassette, lands in the favourable zone with an n-region charge of +4, a hydrophobic core mean of 1.65 and a clean A-X-A site; AprE is the best-matched alternative and AmyE the weakest. The ranking is worth what such rankings are worth: signal peptide performance is strongly cargo-specific and empirical screens of more than a hundred routinely find the winner is protein-dependent. The screen chose which three to put in a wet-lab panel, and it does not replace one.
questions.answer_zh: 密碼子模型只排序前驅物供給。Peptide Design 頁寫明：它對訊號辨識靶向、轉位酶通量，或膜另一側等著的品管蛋白酶都沒有說任何話，它也不是產量預測。訊號肽面板是依 n 區電荷、h 區疏水性與長度，以及取自已驗證 UniProt 序列的 −3/−1 切割規則來排名。我們卡匣中原有的 SamyQ 落在有利區間，n 區電荷 +4、疏水核心平均 1.65、A-X-A 切割位乾淨；AprE 是最匹配的替代，AmyE 最弱。這個排名的價值就只有這類排名的價值：訊號肽表現高度依賴貨物蛋白，超過一百條的實證篩選一再發現勝出者因蛋白而異。這個篩選決定了要把哪三個放進濕式實驗面板，它不能取代那個面板。

questions.q: Six cassettes went to synthesis on 20 August. Name them and say why three of the six are controls.
questions.q_zh: 八月二十日有六個卡匣送去合成。請說出它們，並說明為什麼其中三個是對照。
questions.answer: D-01 BoPep4_9-23_NHis at 691 bp, the activity lead and the only lead a western blot can see; D-02 G17A_1-23_NHis at 715 bp; D-03 WT_1-23_NHis at 715 bp; D-04 9-23_native at 673 bp, the same lead untagged; D-05 WT_1-23_native at 697 bp, exactly the natural molecule; D-06 S15A_1-23_NHis at 715 bp. D-03, D-06 and D-02 are wild type, S15A and G17A on one backbone, about one-fold, about hundredfold and more than four thousandfold down in Pearce's measurements, which is four orders of magnitude of expected effect. Drop D-06 and the set collapses into a binary switch that can show the peptide works but cannot show the platform ranks variants. Nothing is fused after Asn23 and no spacer was inserted, so each tagged construct has an untagged twin and the tag comparison is single-variable.
questions.answer_zh: D-01 BoPep4_9-23_NHis，691 bp，活性主力，也是唯一能被西方墨點法看見的主力；D-02 G17A_1-23_NHis，715 bp；D-03 WT_1-23_NHis，715 bp；D-04 9-23_native，673 bp，同一主力但無標籤；D-05 WT_1-23_native，697 bp，正是天然分子；D-06 S15A_1-23_NHis，715 bp。D-03、D-06 與 D-02 是同一骨架上的野生型、S15A 與 G17A，在 Pearce 的量測中分別約為 1 倍、約 100 倍與超過 4,000 倍的活性下降，橫跨四個數量級的預期效應。少了 D-06，整組就塌成一個二元開關，只能顯示肽有效，無法顯示平台能排序變異體。Asn23 之後沒有任何融合，也沒有插入間隔子，因此每個帶標籤的構築體都有一個無標籤的對應體，標籤比較是單變數的。
questions.trap: Calling the set six independent designs. Three of the six are graded controls with published effect sizes, and the point of the order is the ladder they make.
questions.trap_zh: 把這組稱為六個獨立設計。其中三個是具已發表效應量的分級對照，這批訂單的重點正是它們構成的階梯。

questions.q: Peptide Design says every construct ordered after 16 August ends in a free carboxylate. Your Parts cassettes end in a 6xHis tag. How do you resolve that?
questions.q_zh: Peptide Design 頁說八月十六日之後下訂的每個構築體都以自由羧酸根結尾，但你們 Parts 頁的卡匣結尾是 6xHis 標籤。這要怎麼解決？
questions.answer: We cannot resolve it in our favour, and we should say so. Peptide Design's decision is explicit: every affinity tag moved to the N terminus and every construct ordered after 16 August ends in a free G-G-H-N carboxylate, with the seven already-tagged cassettes retained only as secretion and yield reporters, not for bioactivity. But Parts writes the SamyQ-BoPep4-v2t1 and v2t2 cassettes, and the SamyQ-LEA and SamyQ-ACCD cassettes, as signal peptide then CDS then 6xHis tag then terminator, and v2t1 was sequence-verified at Level 0 on 19 August, the day before the new order. Methodology's codon section also records appending a C-terminal 6xHis in Phase 2. For LEA14 and ACC deaminase a C-terminal tag is not the same lesion, since the Asn23 argument is specific to the peptide, but for BoPep4 it is, and the records disagree about what was built. The right answer is to settle which cassettes carry the tag at which end before any of them is read out for bioactivity.
questions.answer_zh: 我們無法以對自己有利的方式解決，也應該承認。Peptide Design 頁的決定很明確：所有親和標籤移到 N 端，八月十六日之後下訂的每個構築體都以自由的 G-G-H-N 羧酸根結尾，而七個已帶標籤的卡匣只保留為分泌與產量報告子，不用於生物活性。但 Parts 頁把 SamyQ-BoPep4-v2t1 與 v2t2，以及 SamyQ-LEA 與 SamyQ-ACCD 卡匣寫成訊號肽、CDS、6xHis 標籤、終止子的順序，而 v2t1 在八月十九日於 Level 0 完成定序確認，正是新訂單的前一天。方法論頁的密碼子段落也記錄在第二階段附加 C 端 6xHis。對 LEA14 與 ACC 去胺酶而言，C 端標籤不是同一種損傷，因為 Asn23 的論點是這條肽特有的；但對 BoPep4 就是，而我們的記錄對實際做了什麼彼此不一致。正確的做法是在任何卡匣被用來讀取生物活性之前，先確認哪些卡匣的標籤在哪一端。
questions.trap: Saying the C-terminal cassettes were cancelled. They were not; they stayed in the project as reporters, and the Parts record shows at least one sequence-verified.
questions.trap_zh: 說 C 端卡匣已被取消。並沒有；它們以報告子身分留在專案中，而 Parts 的記錄顯示至少有一個已完成定序確認。

questions.q: What is the strongest statement you can make about any of the three protectants working?
questions.q_zh: 關於三種保護劑的有效性，你們能做出最強的陳述是什麼？
questions.answer: That the sequences are structurally capable of the recognition step, for BoPep4, and nothing stronger for the other two. The Protein Design hub states the standing limit: none of this has been applied to a plant, and every statement in the section is about a molecule, a model or a sequence. Peptide Design keeps 'the peptide is active in planta' as an open claim with no assay run, and 'the chassis secretes it at a measurable titre' as the cheapest experiment still outstanding. Parts says plainly that LEA14 and BoPep4 have never touched a plant and that no four-way protectant comparison can be made from this evidence. For ACC deaminase, Results and Measurement both record that there is no activity assay, no ELISA and no enzyme kinetics anywhere in the archive, the 24 August western blot found no detectable ACC deaminase in the B. subtilis preparation being sprayed, and experiment set 8 produced no number.
questions.answer_zh: 就 BoPep4 而言，最強的陳述是這些序列在結構上有能力完成辨識這一步；另外兩種則連這個都談不上。Protein Design 首頁寫下既存限制：這一切都未施用於植物，整個章節的每一項陳述都是關於分子、模型或序列。Peptide Design 頁把「這條肽在植物體內有活性」列為未解主張，且無任何分析執行；把「底盤以可量測的效價分泌它」列為仍未完成、成本最低的實驗。Parts 頁明說 LEA14 與 BoPep4 從未接觸過植物，而這些證據無法支撐四方保護劑比較。至於 ACC 去胺酶，Results 與 Measurement 兩頁都記錄檔案中沒有任何活性分析、ELISA 或酵素動力學；八月二十四日的西方墨點在正被噴灑的 B. subtilis 製備物中測不到 ACC 去胺酶；而第 8 組實驗沒有產出任何數字。
questions.trap: Offering the bioreactor fractionation blot as protectant efficacy. It is one blot showing ACC deaminase in the supernatant, with no loading control, and it speaks to secretion, not to activity or to any plant effect.
questions.trap_zh: 拿生物反應器的分層墨點當成保護劑效果。那是一張顯示上清液中有 ACC 去胺酶的墨點，沒有載量對照，說的是分泌，不是活性，也不是任何植物效果。

questions.q: If the point is to test whether BoPep4 protects a plant, why not just buy a synthetic peptide and skip the secretion problem?
questions.q_zh: 如果目的是檢驗 BoPep4 能否保護植物，為什麼不直接買合成肽，跳過分泌問題？
questions.answer: We are doing both. A chemically synthesised reference peptide at a known concentration was placed alongside the six cassettes, and Peptide Design names it as one of the four controls the assay cannot be interpreted without, because it is the only thing that separates 'the peptide does not work' from 'we secreted almost none of it'. The other three are vehicle and empty-vector supernatant, since B. subtilis supernatant carries proteases and surfactin; the dead fragment at the same molar load; and quantification before activity. The cassettes exist because on-site production is the project, not because synthesis would not answer the biology. One ordering trap is recorded: a synthetic peptide has to specify a C-terminal free acid, because peptide houses ship a C-terminal amide by default and that re-creates the same lesion as the C-terminal tag.
questions.answer_zh: 我們兩條路都走。一個已知濃度的化學合成參考肽與六個卡匣一併訂購，而 Peptide Design 頁把它列為分析無法解讀就少不了的四個對照之一，因為它是唯一能區分「這條肽無效」與「我們幾乎沒分泌出來」的東西。另外三個是載體與空載體上清液對照，因為 B. subtilis 上清液帶有蛋白酶與表面活性素；等莫耳量的失活片段；以及先定量再談活性。卡匣存在是因為就地生產本身就是這個專案，而不是因為合成肽回答不了生物學問題。訂購上有一個陷阱被記錄下來：合成肽必須指定 C 端為自由酸，因為肽合成廠預設出貨 C 端醯胺，而那會重現與 C 端標籤相同的損傷。

questions.q: Which docking software version and how many runs are behind this section, and is that recorded consistently?
questions.q_zh: 這個章節背後用的是哪個版本的對接軟體、跑了多少次？記錄是否一致？
questions.answer: Peptide Design's parameter table gives HADDOCK 2.5, distribution haddock2.5-2026-07, run locally, with 121 production runs across seven campaigns, plus AlphaFold3 at five seeds per job over 44 jobs, CNS 1.3 as the energy engine and ViennaRNA 2.7.2 over a 236-nucleotide window. Methodology and Sprints and Results both say HADDOCK 2.4 instead, and Sprints opens by saying every run on the page is a HADDOCK 2.4 docking. We should name the discrepancy rather than pick one on the spot. Peptide Design is the page that carries the per-run parameter and restraint record, so it is the one to check against, and the version line on the other two needs correcting.
questions.answer_zh: Peptide Design 頁的參數表寫的是 HADDOCK 2.5，發行版 haddock2.5-2026-07，在本機執行，橫跨七個批次共 121 次生產執行；另有 AlphaFold3 每個工作五個種子、共 44 個工作，能量引擎為 CNS 1.3，ViennaRNA 2.7.2 跑 236 個核苷酸的窗口。方法論與 Sprints and Results 兩頁都寫 HADDOCK 2.4，而 Sprints 開頭就說該頁每一次執行都是 HADDOCK 2.4 對接。我們應該指出這個不一致，而不是當場挑一個。Peptide Design 是承載逐次參數與限制記錄的頁面，應以它為查核基準，另兩頁的版本敘述需要修正。
questions.trap: Picking one version confidently. Three pages in the same section disagree, and a judge who has read the wiki will have noticed.
questions.trap_zh: 很有信心地挑一個版本。同一章節的三個頁面彼此不一致，讀過維基的評審會注意到。
